REDU.description: Force Reduction Factor (REDU). Fields drive the reduction factor applied to member design forces and which force components it is applied to.

FACTOR.description: Reduction factor applied to the selected design force components. Must be between 0.3 and 1.0 (inclusive); values outside this range are rejected.

COMPONENTS.description: Applied force components: which internal forces the reduction factor is applied to.

AXIAL.description: Apply the reduction factor to axial force.

MOMENT.description: Apply the reduction factor to moments.

SHEAR.description: Apply the reduction factor to shear forces.
